sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin, and I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶时代夜店打碟的日子里，每天晚上你都会把300件最珍爱的藏品

sentences.en: to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful
sentences.zh: 带去工作，你把DJ台变成了一个像是由精美绝伦的

sentences.en: 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 50年老物件组成的移动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就去你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, this event is unprecedented, the National Weather Service tweeted.
sentences.zh: “今天，这场事件是前所未见的，”国家气象局发推文称。

sentences.en: All impacts are unknown, and beyond anything experienced.
sentences.zh: “所有影响都未可知，且超乎以往任何经历。”

sentences.en: A view from the ground in Houston, as the waters keep rising.
sentences.zh: 这是休斯敦实地的视角，随着水位不断上涨。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, August 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月29日，星期二。

sentences.en: What's it like out there?
sentences.zh: 外面情况怎么样？

sentences.en: Pure hell, man.
sentences.zh: 简直是人间炼狱，伙计。

sentences.en: I'm 61 years old.
sentences.zh: 我61岁了。

sentences.en: I've never seen this before since I've been here in Houston all my life.
sentences.zh: 自从我一辈子住在休斯敦以来，我从没见过这阵仗。

sentences.en: You doing okay, sir?
sentences.zh: 你还好吗，先生？

sentences.en: Not really, man.
sentences.zh: 不太好，伙计。

sentences.en: I'm sore.
sentences.zh: 我浑身酸痛。

sentences.en: Yeah, he did a lot of work in that water and so forth.
sentences.zh: 对，他在那水里做了很多工作之类的。

sentences.en: Rescue kids.
sentences.zh: 救援孩子们。

sentences.en: So where are you staying?
sentences.zh: 那你住在哪里？

sentences.en: Right here.
sentences.zh: 就在这儿。

sentences.en: Right, but like, where did you stay last night?
sentences.zh: 对，但我是说，你昨晚住哪儿？

sentences.en: In my car.
sentences.zh: 在我的车里。

sentences.en: Oh, where's your car?
sentences.zh: 哦，你的车在哪儿？

sentences.en: Right over there.
sentences.zh: 就在那边。

sentences.en: Jeep Compass.
sentences.zh: 吉普指南者。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm sleeping in my car right now.
sentences.zh: 对，我现在就睡在车里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: We were here late last night.
sentences.zh: 我们昨晚很晚才到这儿。

sentences.en: The dump trucks kept pulling up.
sentences.zh: 运货卡车一辆接一辆地开过来。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: People were getting off and rushing in and trying to get out of the cold and the wet.
sentences.zh: 人们下车冲进来，试图躲避寒冷和潮湿。

sentences.en: Yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 是的，长官。

sentences.en: How much sleep did you get last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚睡了多久？

sentences.en: I didn't sleep last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚没睡。

sentences.en: When do you think he'll sleep again?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他什么时候能再睡会儿？

sentences.en: Probably sometime this evening.
sentences.zh: 大概今天傍晚吧。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: By Monday, the third straight day of flooding, Hurricane Harvey had left much of the region underwater, and the city of Houston looked like a sea dotted by small islands.
sentences.zh: 到星期一，即持续洪涝的第三天，飓风哈维已将该地区大片浸泡在水中，休斯敦市看起来就像一片点缀着小岛的海洋。

sentences.en: It was just coming down and coming down and coming down.
sentences.zh: 雨水不停地倾盆而下，倾盆而下，倾盆而下。

sentences.en: You've got interstates that are partly blocked off.
sentences.zh: 有些州际公路部分被封锁。

sentences.en: You have residential streets that are completely submerged in water.
sentences.zh: 有些住宅街道完全被水淹没。

sentences.en: One of my colleagues was out with a rescue team and said their boat kept bumping into cars that were completely covered by water.
sentences.zh: 我的一个同事跟救援队一起出去，说他们的船一直撞到完全被水淹没的汽车。

sentences.en: You have bus shelters that are halfway submerged, and it's just
sentences.zh: 公交候车亭有一半被淹没，这简直是

sentences.en: an absolute drenching.
sentences.zh: 一场透心凉的暴雨。

sentences.en: My colleague Alan Blinder spent the day in downtown Houston.
sentences.zh: 我的同事艾伦·布林德在休斯敦市中心度过了一天。

sentences.en: Houston is the nation's fourth largest city.
sentences.zh: 休斯敦是全美第四大城市。

sentences.en: You have millions upon millions of people in the greater Houston area.
sentences.zh: 在大休斯敦地区有数以千万计的人口。

sentences.en: And one of the issues here, and it's going to be long debated, is that there was no evacuation order, voluntary or mandatory, from the county, from the city.
sentences.zh: 这里的问题之一——这也将引发长期争论——是无论是县里还是市里，都没有发布自愿或强制撤离令。

sentences.en: Officials here have argued there wasn't enough time.
sentences.zh: 这里的官员辩称，时间不够。

sentences.en: The logistics would have been crazy.
sentences.zh: 物流会变得极其疯狂。

sentences.en: To evacuate people, so many people, on such short notice.
sentences.zh: 在这么短的通知时间内疏散这么多人。

sentences.en: This is a storm that really only revived itself in the Gulf last Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 这是一场上周三才真正在墨西哥湾复苏的风暴。

sentences.en: It made landfall in Texas on Friday as a Category 4 storm, and that was even stronger than anticipated.
sentences.zh: 它于周五以4级风暴强度在得克萨斯州登陆，其强度甚至比预期还要大。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: No one knew which direction it was going to go.
sentences.zh: 没人知道它会朝哪个方向走。

sentences.en: So it's kind of difficult to send people away from danger when you don't know where the danger is.
sentences.zh: 所以当你不清楚危险在哪里时，很难让人们撤离危险区域。

sentences.en: And I think there was a real fear here.
sentences.zh: 我想这里确实存在一种恐惧。

sentences.en: What happens when you put millions of people on the roads with so little notice?
sentences.zh: 在这么短的通知下把数百万人赶上公路会发生什么？

sentences.en: Are you setting them up to be stuck in traffic when a storm-wide car V comes through?
sentences.zh: 当横跨风暴的汽车潮涌来时，你们是不是在让他们陷入交通大堵塞？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then potentially drown in that traffic.
sentences.zh: 然后可能会在那样的交通中溺水身亡。

sentences.en: And potentially drowning.
sentences.zh: 而且可能会溺水。

sentences.en: And I mean, there was a lot of debate the hours before the storm hit, and a lot of people in Houston appear to have stayed to try to ride out the storm.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在风暴来临前的几个小时里有很多争论，休斯敦的许多人似乎选择留下来试图挺过风暴。

sentences.en: My name is Jacqueline Herrera, and I live in Sanco Ranch, Texas.
sentences.zh: 我叫杰奎琳·埃雷拉，我住在得克萨斯州桑科牧场。

sentences.en: We have been inside our home for the last 72 hours.
sentences.zh: 我们在家里已经待了整整72小时。

sentences.en: The water is approximately 30 inches deep in the street out front and about four feet from our front door at this time.
sentences.zh: 目前门外街道上的水大约有30英寸深，距离我们的前门大约有四英尺。

sentences.en: And as of this message at 426 PM, we have not evacuated.
sentences.zh: 截至下午4点26分这条消息发出时，我们还没有撤离。

sentences.en: The entire street is evacuating house by house.
sentences.zh: 整条街正在挨家挨户地撤离。

sentences.en: There are boats pulling up, picking up people at their front doors, and taking them away.
sentences.zh: 有船只开过来，在人们的前门接走他们，然后带他们离开。

sentences.en: Most of them have children with floaties on their arMs. My husband and I and our 17-and-a-half-year-old son are still here, sandbagged in, and deciding what to do.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数是带着手臂漂浮圈的孩子。我和丈夫还有我们17岁半的儿子仍然留在这里，被沙袋围困着，正在决定该怎么办。

sentences.en: We are torn between riding it out or packing up belongings and trash bags, putting them into backpacks, and calling for the boats to come.
sentences.zh: 我们在硬扛过去还是把随身物品塞进垃圾袋和背包、然后呼叫救援船之间举棋不定。

sentences.en: Leaving your home and all of your belongings behind is an incredibly difficult decision to make.
sentences.zh: 抛下你的家和所有的财物是一个极其艰难的决定。

sentences.en: So, Alan, you're at Houston's Convention Center, which has just been converted into a shelter for evacuees.
sentences.zh: 那么，艾伦，你现在在休斯敦的会议中心，这里刚刚被改造成疏散人员的避难所。

sentences.en: What are you seeing there?
sentences.zh: 你在那里看到了什么？

sentences.en: The rescued people of Houston are arriving at the convention center, usually on buses or in the back of dump trucks.
sentences.zh: 休斯敦被营救的人们正抵达会议中心，通常是坐公交车或者乘翻斗卡车的后斗。

sentences.en: Dump trucks?
sentences.zh: 翻斗卡车？

sentences.en: Dump trucks.
sentences.zh: 翻斗卡车。

sentences.en: And it's a way you can put a lot of people onto a vehicle that's high up and move them quickly.
sentences.zh: 这是一种能让大量人员坐上底盘高的车辆并快速转移的方法。

sentences.en: And when you're running out of vehicles and you have so many people spread around town, you use what you have, from what I can tell.
sentences.zh: 据我所能了解到的，当你车辆短缺而又有这么多人分散在城里时，你有什么就用什么。

sentences.en: So you'll see 15, 20, 30 people standing in the back of a dump truck.
sentences.zh: 所以你会看到15、20、30个人站在翻斗卡车的后斗里。

sentences.en: And they arrive at the convention center and they disembark and they walk in and they have this world open up to them of cots and dry clothes and restrooms and showers and such.
sentences.zh: 他们抵达会议中心后下车走进来，展现在他们眼前的是一个充满行军床、干衣服、洗手间和淋浴间等设施的新天地。

sentences.en: There's a security check.
sentences.zh: 这里有安检。

sentences.en: They go through bags.
sentences.zh: 他们检查包袋。

sentences.en: They're looking for weapons, drugs, any kind of contraband.
sentences.zh: 他们在寻找武器、毒品以及任何违禁品。

sentences.en: And as soon as they're through that checkpoint, which the Houston Police Department is running, they register with the
sentences.zh: 一旦他们通过了由休斯敦警察局负责的这个检查站，他们就会去

sentences.en: Red Cross.
sentences.zh: 红十字会登记。

sentences.en: They're given a blanket if they wanted.
sentences.zh: 如果需要的话，会发给他们一条毯子。

sentences.en: I mean, I talked to one woman.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我跟一位女士交谈过。

sentences.en: Excuse me.
sentences.zh: 打扰一下。

sentences.en: I'm a reporter from the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的记者。

sentences.en: Are you feeling okay?
sentences.zh: 你感觉还好吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，挺好的。

sentences.en: Very, very cold though.
sentences.zh: 不过非常非常冷。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是吗。

sentences.en: Very, very cold?
sentences.zh: 非常非常冷？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Do you need a doctor?
sentences.zh: 你需要看医生吗？

sentences.en: No, I'm good.
sentences.zh: 不用，我很好。

sentences.en: She was shivering so badly.
sentences.zh: 她冷得瑟瑟发抖。

sentences.en: They register.
sentences.zh: 他们去登记。

sentences.en: I'll walk with you.
sentences.zh: 我陪你走一段。

sentences.en: Where we going?
sentences.zh: 我们去哪儿？

sentences.en: I think you're going to go register over here.
sentences.zh: 我想你要去那边登记。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: And that lets them into this shelter.
sentences.zh: 这能让他们进入这个避难所。

sentences.en: We're all together.
sentences.zh: 我们都在一起。

sentences.en: You're all together, right?
sentences.zh: 你们都在一起，对吧？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，对。

sentences.en: Where's Fred?
sentences.zh: 弗雷德在哪儿？

sentences.en: Where's your buddy?
sentences.zh: 你的伙伴呢？

sentences.en: Buddy's behind you.
sentences.zh: 伙伴在你身后呢。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're here.
sentences.zh: 对，我们在这儿。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We're here.
sentences.zh: 我们在这儿。

sentences.en: For a lot of people, there's a mental exhaustion, a physical exhaustion setting in.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，精神上的疲惫和身体上的疲惫正在袭来。

sentences.en: So for them, any kind of place just to lay down for a little while is appealing.
sentences.zh: 所以对他们而言，任何能躺下来休息一会儿的地方都很有吸引力。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你还好吗？

sentences.en: Cold, wet, hungry, and want to get dry?
sentences.zh: 又冷、又湿、又饿，还想烘干身子？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We had a bad night last night.
sentences.zh: 我们昨晚过得很糟。

sentences.en: Yes, we did.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about it?
sentences.zh: 能跟我讲讲吗？

sentences.en: Man, our house got flooded by five inches of water.
sentences.zh: 伙计，我们的房子被五英寸深的水给淹了。

sentences.en: Everything started floating in our house.
sentences.zh: 屋里的所有东西都漂起来了。

sentences.en: So how were you rescued?
sentences.zh: 那你们是怎么获救的？

sentences.en: Was it a helicopter?
sentences.zh: 是直升机吗？

sentences.en: Oh, 18 wheeler.
sentences.zh: 哦，18轮大货车。

sentences.en: And they just came and got you in?
sentences.zh: 他们直接过来把你们接上去的？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: They came and got us, put us on dry land.
sentences.zh: 他们来接我们，把我们送到干燥的陆地上。

sentences.en: So then they brought you over here just a few minutes?
sentences.zh: 然后他们就把你们带到这里，就几分钟前？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Were you all in that dump truck that you rolled up?
sentences.zh: 你们都坐了刚才开过来的那辆翻斗卡车吗？

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: What have the last 24 hours been like for you?
sentences.zh: 过去的24小时对你们来说是怎样的体验？

sentences.en: Hell.
sentences.zh: 简直是炼狱。

sentences.en: You know, outside of downtown, there are continuing search and rescue operations happening here.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在市中心之外，搜救行动还在继续进行。

sentences.en: The city has not entered into a recovery mode at this point.
sentences.zh: 目前该市尚未进入灾后恢复模式。

sentences.en: They're still hoping to find people.
sentences.zh: 他们仍希望能找到人。

sentences.en: I mean, there are still helicopters and boats and people searching, looking for people who still need to be saved.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，仍然有直升机、船只和搜救人员在寻找那些仍然需要被拯救的人。

sentences.en: That's why there are still people flowing into the convention center.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么源源不断的人流还在涌入会议中心。

sentences.en: Hone, do you have a sense of how many people have been displaced by this hurricane turned now into a tropical storm?
sentences.zh: 霍恩，你大致了解有多少人因为这场由飓风转为热带风暴的灾害而流离失所吗？

sentences.en: And how many people are packing into the convention center?
sentences.zh: 又有多少人正涌入会议中心？

sentences.en: You've got thousands at this convention center alone.
sentences.zh: 仅在这个会议中心就有数千人。

sentences.en: But the fact is that FEMA has estimated that there are going to be about 30,000 people who are going to need some kind of shelter in Texas.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，联邦紧急事务管理局估计，得克萨斯州将有大约3万人需要某种形式的庇护。

sentences.en: Because they can't stay in their homes.
sentences.zh: 因为他们无法待在自己家里。

sentences.en: Because they can't stay in their homes, they have no other place to go, they can't afford a hotel, they don't have family nearby, they thought the waters would stay away,
sentences.zh: 因为他们无法待在家里，没有其他地方可去，住不起酒店，附近也没有亲戚，他们以为洪水不会漫过来，

sentences.en: they would be lower, what have you.
sentences.zh: 水位会更低，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And they woke up and found themselves trapped.
sentences.zh: 他们醒来后发现自己被困住了。

sentences.en: These are all people who had to come here because they were caught unaware, caught by surprise.
sentences.zh: 这些人都是猝不及防、毫无准备，才不得不来到这里的。

sentences.en: They were alarmed by what they were seeing as the floodwaters just rose and rose and rose.
sentences.zh: 看着洪水不断上涨、上涨、再上涨，他们感到十分惊慌。

sentences.en: And when you say they were caught by surprise, help listeners understand what you mean by that.
sentences.zh: 当你说他们毫无防备时，能帮听众理解你是什么意思吗？

sentences.en: I mean, a hurricane was barreling towards Houston, and it certainly seemed like something that was going to be quite devastating.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一场飓风正朝休斯顿席卷而来，这看起来确实是一场极具毁灭性的灾难。

sentences.en: So why does it feel like so many people are startled by what they're seeing?
sentences.zh: 那为什么感觉有这么多人对眼前看到的一切感到震惊呢？

sentences.en: I think that people I've talked to were surprised by the magnitude of the storm.
sentences.zh: 我认为我交谈过的人都对这场风暴的规模感到意外。

sentences.en: The National Weather Service has called the event unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 国家气象局称这次事件史无前例。

sentences.en: It's unlike anything that's ever been experienced here.
sentences.zh: 这与这里以往经历过的任何风暴都不同。

sentences.en: And this is a city that was some familiarity with flooding, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，这座城市对洪水并不陌生。

sentences.en: But I think people, because of that familiarity with flooding, just thought they could ride it out.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得大家正是因为对洪水有这种熟悉感，才以为自己能挺过去。

sentences.en: They didn't think it would be a storm where we'd be measuring rainfalls in terms of feet, not inches.
sentences.zh: 他们没想到这会是一场以“英尺”而非“英寸”来衡量降雨量的风暴。

sentences.en: I won't shake your hand since you're all bundled up.
sentences.zh: 看你裹得这么严实，我就不跟你握手了。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you, sir.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识你，先生。

sentences.en: Good to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: I talked to one woman this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上采访了一位女士。

sentences.en: My name's Kapoor, and we're from the north side.
sentences.zh: 我叫卡普尔，我们来自北区。

sentences.en: We talked about how she had lived in Houston for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了聊她是如何在休斯顿生活了许多许多年的。

sentences.en: Actually, I've just been out there about 20 years.
sentences.zh: 其实，我搬到那里大概20年了。

sentences.en: Yeah, a long time.
sentences.zh: 对，挺长时间了。

sentences.en: That's been a long while.
sentences.zh: 那确实是很长一段时间了。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: So you've been through hurricanes there before.
sentences.zh: 所以你在那里经历过飓风。

sentences.en: Yes, sir, we have.
sentences.zh: 是的，先生，我们经历过。

sentences.en: But this has been one of the worst for me.
sentences.zh: 但对我说，这是最糟糕的一次之一。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because I've never experienced being in the water.
sentences.zh: 因为我从来没有亲身泡在水里过。

sentences.en: I mean, going and helping people, yes.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，去帮助别人，有过。

sentences.en: But as far as losing everything, it's the first time that I've lost everything.
sentences.zh: 但要说失去一切，这是我头一次失去所有东西。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about the last couple days before you come forward?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我讲讲你撤离前那几天的情况吗？

sentences.en: It started at home, because I do home health care.
sentences.zh: 事情是从家里开始的，因为我从事居家医疗护理。

sentences.en: So I had to get my patient, who was paralyzed.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须照顾我那瘫痪的病人。

sentences.en: So we had to get him out, put him in the boat, which we had a boat in the backyard, thank God.
sentences.zh: 我们得把他弄出来，放到船上——谢天谢地，我们在后院备了一艘船。

sentences.en: So we put him in the boat with some of our neighbors' help.
sentences.zh: 于是在邻居们的帮助下，我们把他弄上了船。

sentences.en: And we pushed him all the way to the library, which was the shelter.
sentences.zh: 我们一路把他推到了作为避难所的图书馆。

sentences.en: And today they came and got us, so we've been here about an hour.
sentences.zh: 今天他们来接了我们，所以我们在这里大约有一个小时了。

sentences.en: What's all the stuff that you brought?
sentences.zh: 你都带了些什么东西？

sentences.en: What do you have with you here?
sentences.zh: 你这里随身带着什么？

sentences.en: We had some supplies.
sentences.zh: 我们带了一些物资。

sentences.en: Is there a jar of mayonnaise in there?
sentences.zh: 那里面有一罐蛋黄酱吗？

sentences.en: Yep, there's mayonnaise and tuna and Vienna sausages.
sentences.zh: 对，有蛋黄酱、金枪鱼还有维也纳香肠。

sentences.en: And we have alcohol.
sentences.zh: 我们还有酒精。

sentences.en: And we had alcohol.
sentences.zh: 我们还带了酒精。

sentences.en: There you go.
sentences.zh: 这就对了。

sentences.en: But to get us through, man, you know, it's been a little rough, but we got it.
sentences.zh: 但为了撑过来，老兄，你知道的，过程有点艰难，但我们挺过来了。

sentences.en: Were you relieved when you arrived here?
sentences.zh: 你到达这里时松了一口气吗？

sentences.en: Were you nervous?
sentences.zh: 你当时紧张吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I'm still nervous.
sentences.zh: 是的，我还是很紧张。

sentences.en: I'm still nervous.
sentences.zh: 我还是很紧张。

sentences.en: I'm glad that we got away from all that water because it started back raining and the water was starting back to rise.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴我们逃离了那些水，因为天又开始下雨了，水开始上涨了。

sentences.en: So I'm glad that they did get us here, my husband and I, you know, and the rest of our friends and family.
sentences.zh: 所以我很高兴他们把我们——我和我丈夫，你知道的，还有其他亲友——接到了这里。

sentences.en: Why are you nervous being here?
sentences.zh: 为什么来到这里你还会紧张？

sentences.en: Strange people.
sentences.zh: 周围都是陌生人。

sentences.en: You know, you have to be aware of your surroundings.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你必须对周围的环境保持警惕。

sentences.en: You know, like, for instance, when Katrina came, you know, I mean, there was a lot of rapes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，比如卡特里娜飓风来袭时，你知道的，发生了大量的强奸案。

sentences.en: There was a lot of, you know, like I tell people, we just have to be aware of our surroundings and just watch each other, you know.
sentences.zh: 有很多，你知道的，就像我对别人说的，我们必须时刻注意周围环境，互相守望，你知道的。

sentences.en: But I think they got it, from past experiences, I think they got it pretty much down pat.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得他们通过过去的经验，已经基本上把这些都摸透了。

sentences.en: So you're feeling pretty confident that there won't be a super down pat.
sentences.zh: 所以你觉得很自信，不会再有那种……

sentences.en: No, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: I feel confident in Houston, my city.
sentences.zh: 我对休斯顿，我的城市充满信心。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: People have talked with me about it.
sentences.zh: 人们和我谈过这件事。

sentences.en: They know the history of what happened in New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 他们知道新奥尔良曾经发生过什么历史。

sentences.en: And they're aware of it, and they're aware it could happen here.
sentences.zh: 他们对此心知肚明，也知道这可能会在这里发生。

sentences.en: I mean, people are emotional.
sentences.zh: 我是说，人们情绪激动。

sentences.en: They are frustrated.
sentences.zh: 他们感到沮丧。

sentences.en: They're sad.
sentences.zh: 他们感到难过。

sentences.en: They've had a long few days.
sentences.zh: 过去的几天对他们来说太漫长了。

sentences.en: It seems like, by and large, Hurricane Harvey is being described constantly in its relativity to Hurricane Katrina.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，人们在描述飓风哈维时，似乎总是把它与卡特里娜飓风进行对比。

sentences.en: Now, why is that comparison being made?
sentences.zh: 现在，为什么要进行这种对比呢？

sentences.en: And is it looking like it could be as devastating as Katrina was to New Orleans?
sentences.zh: 它看起来会像卡特里娜对新奥尔良那样具有毁灭性吗？

sentences.en: I think it remains to be seen because you've got still days more rain coming.
sentences.zh: 我认为这还有待观察，因为未来几天还会有更多降雨。

sentences.en: I think when you see pictures and videos of people being airlifted from the roofs of their houses, flooding into these types of shelters, seeking any kind of help they can,
sentences.zh: 我想，当你看到人们从房屋屋顶被空运撤离、涌入这类避难所、寻求各种可能帮助的照片和视频时，

sentences.en: a lot of people automatically think back to Katrina.
sentences.zh: 很多人自然而然地就会回想起卡特里娜飓风。

sentences.en: But I think there's a potential that this becomes a bigger calamity than Katrina, mainly because it is going to take so long for the storm to go away.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，这场灾难有可能会变得比卡特里娜更严重，主要是因为这场风暴消散需要太长时间。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I remember with Katrina that the devastation was unknowable until the water had receded.
sentences.zh: 我记得在卡特里娜飓风中，直到洪水退去，破坏的程度才真正为人所知。

sentences.en: And that's probably the grimmest thing of all here in Houston is that there's a double-digit death toll now in Texas from the storm.
sentences.zh: 而这可能也是休斯顿最残酷的事情，因为这场风暴已经导致德克萨斯州出现了两位数的死亡人数。

sentences.en: And I think there's a recognition that eventually when the authorities go house to house, they will probably find bodies.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们已经意识到，最终当当局挨家挨户搜查时，他们可能会发现尸体。

sentences.en: No one knows how many people didn't make it to the rooftop.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道有多少人没能爬上屋顶。

sentences.en: No one knows how many people went to their attic to try to wait it out and didn't have a way to get out of the attic.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道有多少人躲进阁楼试图熬过风暴，结果却被困在阁楼里出不去。

sentences.en: And the most frightening thing of all to a lot of people in Houston is that the rain is not over yet.
sentences.zh: 对于休斯顿的许多人来说，最可怕的事情是雨还没下完。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, it's been raining most of the day here.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这里几乎下一整天雨了。

sentences.en: It rained almost all of Sunday, and we still have more to go.
sentences.zh: 周日几乎下了一整天，而且雨还没完。

sentences.en: And back to the convention center, what are the people there preparing for?
sentences.zh: 回到会展中心，那里的人们在准备什么？

sentences.en: Can they see their way out of it?
sentences.zh: 他们能看到出路吗？

sentences.en: I think they can see a way out for some of them.
sentences.zh: 我想他们能为其中一些人找到出路。

sentences.en: I think others are really unsure of what comes next.
sentences.zh: 我觉得其他人对接下来会发生什么真的感到很不确定。

sentences.en: I mean, I asked some people, you know, how long are you going to be here?
sentences.zh: 我是说，我问过一些人，你们打算在这里待多久？

sentences.en: And I got a lot of shrugs, a lot of I don't knows.
sentences.zh: 我得到很多耸肩和无数个“不知道”。

sentences.en: I think they're just waiting to see what happens.
sentences.zh: 我想他们只是在等待事情的发展。

sentences.en: They're waiting for the rain to stop.
sentences.zh: 他们在等雨停。

sentences.en: I think everyone here is.
sentences.zh: 我想这里的每个人都在等。

sentences.en: Alan Blinder, thank you very much for your time, and stay safe.
sentences.zh: 阿兰·布林德，非常感谢你抽出时间，请注意安全。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: See you soon.
sentences.zh: 回头见。

sentences.en: This is Jacqueline.
sentences.zh: 这是杰奎琳。

sentences.en: Hey, Jacqueline, it's Michael Barbaro from The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 嘿，杰奎琳，我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: You had left us a voicemail saying that as of a few hours ago, you had an incredibly difficult decision to make about leaving your home,
sentences.zh: 你给我们留过语音留言，说就在几个小时前，你面临着一个极其艰难的决定，关于是否要离开家，

sentences.en: that the water outside was about to reach your door, and you had to make a call very soon about whether to stay or go.
sentences.zh: 外面的水就要漫到门口了，你必须很快做出是留还是走的决定。

sentences.en: So have you made that decision?
sentences.zh: 所以，你做出那个决定了吗？

sentences.en: No, I have care in the house.
sentences.zh: 没有，家里有人需要照顾。

sentences.en: It's incredibly difficult.
sentences.zh: 这实在是太难了。

sentences.en: It doesn't get any easier as the moments go on.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，事情并没有变得更容易。

sentences.en: As the water gets closer and closer to the front door, you would think that it would be easy, and it's not.
sentences.zh: 当水离前门越来越近时，你可能会觉得做决定很容易，其实不然。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 一点也不容易。

sentences.en: How much closer is the water getting?
sentences.zh: 水逼近的速度有多快？

sentences.en: If you look out your front door or your back door, as the case may be, what are you seeing?
sentences.zh: 如果你朝前门或后门看去，具体情况视你所在位置而定，你看到了什么？

sentences.en: Um, the front door, let me go, I'm outside, and it's raining, pouring, downpouring rain right now, and it's a lake.
sentences.zh: 嗯，前门，让我去看看，我在外面，正在下雨，倾盆大雨，现在雨下得很大，外面就像一个湖。

sentences.en: So it just looks like somebody plopped home down in a large lake.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来就像有人把家直接扔进了一个大湖里。

sentences.en: That must be so disorienting.
sentences.zh: 那一定让人感到非常迷失方向。

sentences.en: It's horrific, and it's worse because usually you hear traffic where we live.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了，而且更糟糕的是，在我们住的地方平时能听到交通的声音。

sentences.en: All you hear now is boat motors.
sentences.zh: 现在你听到的全是船只马达的轰鸣声。

sentences.en: Left and right, all around, is boat motors.
sentences.zh: 左右四周，到处都是船只马达声。

sentences.en: You know, you see the people coming out the front door, getting in the boat and taking off, and you're like, okay, everybody's leaving.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你看着人们从前门出来，上船然后离开，你就会想，好吧，大家都走了。

sentences.en: We're staying.
sentences.zh: 我们要留下来。

sentences.en: Is this the wrong decision?
sentences.zh: 这是个错误的决定吗？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You know, I googled the town you live in, and from what I can tell, it is idyllic.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我用谷歌搜索了你住的镇子，据我所知，那里简直是世外桃源。

sentences.en: I mean, it's just a beautiful neighborhood of what looks like new homes and beautiful waterways in between them.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那是一个美丽的社区，看起来有崭新的房屋，中间还有美丽的河道。

sentences.en: And I wonder, are you living in your dream home, and does that have anything to do with this?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你是不是住在你的梦想之家中，这与你的决定有关吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm 40 years old, and this is the most amazing place I've ever lived in my whole life.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我40岁了，这是我一生中住过最棒的地方。

sentences.en: And these boats, when they pull up, it looks like they're able to take a small bin and a backpack.
sentences.zh: 这些船靠岸时，看起来他们只能带上一个小箱子和一个双肩包。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就这些。

sentences.en: So, how do you choose what to put in there?
sentences.zh: 所以，你该如何选择把什么东西放进去呢？

sentences.en: We'll make that call.
sentences.zh: 我们会做决定的。

sentences.en: If it gets dark, and things are getting worse, and we don't want to risk it overnight, we will go.
sentences.zh: 如果天黑了，情况变得更糟，而我们不想冒着过夜的风险，我们就会走。

sentences.en: But, just, we're not there yet.
sentences.zh: 但是，只是，我们还没到那一步。

sentences.en: I mean, what time is it here?
sentences.zh: 我是说，现在几点了？

sentences.en: So, we have about, in our estimation, four hours, probably, to make that decision.
sentences.zh: 所以，据我们估计，我们大概还有四个小时来做出那个决定。

sentences.en: I figure.
sentences.zh: 我想是这样的。

sentences.en: Yes, we're, hold on.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们，等等。

sentences.en: We're good.
sentences.zh: 我们很好。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: We're hanging out for now.
sentences.zh: 我们目前先在这里待着。

sentences.en: Besides, we're not good.
sentences.zh: 再说，我们现在情况并不好。

sentences.en: What, who do we call?
sentences.zh: 什么，我们该打电话给谁？

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: And you turn them down.
sentences.zh: 而你拒绝了他们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, you said you haven't decided whether to stay or go.
sentences.zh: 所以，你刚才说你还没决定是留还是走。

sentences.en: But if I'm, if I'm hearing you correctly, in a sense, you have decided to stay.
sentences.zh: 但如果我没听错的话，从某种意义上说，你已经决定留下来了。

sentences.en: At this time, yes.
sentences.zh: 目前来看，是的。

sentences.en: Until, yeah, I guess you're right.
sentences.zh: 直到，对，我想你是对的。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Maybe we're stupid.
sentences.zh: 也许我们很蠢。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But it's hard to leave your entire life behind and not know what's going to happen overnight.
sentences.zh: 但要把你整个人生抛在脑后，又不知道一夜之间会发生什么，这很难。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯 DealBook 的商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download The New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得一个月的免费权限阅读我们所有的新闻。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你会收听。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过它的。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: The Times reports that shortly after Donald Trump entered the presidential race, one of his business associates promised to work with Russian President Vladimir Putin
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，在唐纳德·特朗普参加总统竞选后不久，他的一位商业伙伴曾承诺与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京合作

sentences.en: to put together a real estate deal for a Trump Tower in Moscow, saying, quote,
sentences.zh: 为莫斯科的特朗普大厦敲定一笔房地产交易，并引用原话说：

sentences.en: I will get Putin on this program, and we will get Donald elected.
sentences.zh: 我会让普京参与这个项目，我们一定会让唐纳德当选。

sentences.en: Felix Sater, a longtime friend of Trump's, wrote a series of emails to Trump's lawyer in 2015, bragging about his ties to Putin.
sentences.zh: 菲利克斯·萨特是特朗普的老朋友，他在 2015 年给特朗普的律师写了一系列电子邮件，吹嘘他与普京的关系。

sentences.en: Our boy can become president of the USA, and we can engineer it, he wrote.
sentences.zh: 他写道，我们的人可以成为美国总统，我们能促成此事。

sentences.en: I will get all of Putin's team to buy in on this.
sentences.zh: 我会让普京的所有团队都接受这一点。

sentences.en: The tower was never built, but communications between Trump's advisers and the Putin government are now the subject of multiple federal investigations into potential collusion.
sentences.zh: 这座大楼从未建成，但特朗普顾问与普京政府之间的通讯现在正成为多项联邦调查潜在勾结的主题。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: President Trump, this day, is issuing an executive order that will make it easier to protect yourselves and your communities.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统今天正在签署一项行政命令，这将使保护你们自己和你们的社区变得更容易。

sentences.en: The Trump administration is allowing police departments to purchase military equipment, typically used in warfare, including grenade launchers, armored vehicles, and bayonets.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府允许警察部门购买通常用于战争的军事装备，包括榴弹发射器、装甲车和刺刀。

sentences.en: The executive order reverses limits put in place by the Obama administration in 2015, after a series of high-profile deaths of black men at the hands of police.
sentences.zh: 该行政命令推翻了奥巴马政府于 2015 年在一系列引发广泛关注的黑人男子死于警察之手的事件后所设定的限制。

sentences.en: These restrictions that had been opposed went too far.
sentences.zh: 这些遭到反对的限制走得太远了。

sentences.en: We will not put superficial concerns above public safety.
sentences.zh: 我们不会将表面的担忧置于公共安全之上。

sentences.en: We will do our best to get you what you need.
sentences.zh: 我们会尽最大努力为您提供所需的东西。

sentences.en: In a speech on Monday before police officers in Tennessee,
sentences.zh: 周一，在田纳西州对警察发表的讲话中，

sentences.en: Attorney General Jeff Sessions called the military equipment life-saving gear.
sentences.zh: 司法部长杰夫·塞申斯称这些军事装备为救命装备。

sentences.en: And we vow to do all in our power to further our resolve to protect, respect, and preserve, and honor law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 我们发誓尽我们所能进一步坚定我们保护、尊重、维护和尊崇执法的决心。

sentences.en: Those of us in leadership roles must say and do nothing that in any way increases the risk you and your colleagues face when they walk the streets of America today.
sentences.zh: 我们这些处于领导地位的人必须不说什么也不做什么，以免以任何方式增加你和你的同事今天走在美利坚街头时所面临的风险。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》节目就到这里。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》上，我们正准备迎接假期的招待活动。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们睡前会失去知觉。

sentences.en: I mean what kind of light do they require because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我是指他们需要什么样的光线，因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用上或您喜欢收听的任何地方寻找《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.en: So I'll see you next time.
sentences.zh: 那么我们下次见。

sentences.en: And that's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
